title: What Is Included in Meta Ads Management? A Full Scope Guide
summary: Meta ads management covers setup, testing, optimization, tracking and reporting, not media spend. See what agencies publish, what fees cover and what to ask.
body_markdown:
## What Meta's automation changes about the job


Meta's[Advantage+ page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus) says its end-to-end campaigns, including sales campaigns, automatically apply AI across a campaign's audience, placement and budget. When the platform handles more of targeting and delivery, an agency's value moves toward three things: the supply of distinct creative, the design of each test and the reading of results.


That is why the question to ask is how many original concepts each month, not only how many files you will receive. Hook swaps on one script are variations of one idea.


## What is not included in the price


Media spend is the main exclusion. Meta's[pricing page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/pricing) says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, so media is always its own line next to the agency's management fee and the cost of making the ads. Meta's[minimum budgets help page](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says Ads Manager requires a minimum budget for each campaign or ad set, varying by country and objective, and shows an alert when a budget is too low. Meta also advises running an ad for at least[7 days](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads) so the system can learn.


Creative production can be a separate line too. In a package like Brighter Click's, confirm the production allocation, onboarding work and total fee, so a quoted monthly price does not leave out ads you expect.

Fees take different shapes: a percentage of spend with a minimum, a flat monthly fee, or a custom quote. Put them on one page at your expected spend before you compare. Our guide to[flat fee versus percentage of ad spend](https://knowlify.com/articles/flat-fee-vs-percentage-of-ad-spend-for-facebook-ads-management) shows how the two scale.


## What to get in writing


- The channels covered: Meta only, or Meta alongside other platforms.
- Who builds the creative, how many original concepts arrive each month, and whether variations count separately.
- Who owns the ad account, pixel and Pages, and how access is granted and removed.
- What reporting you receive, how often, and which metrics it covers, such as cost per result, ROAS and payback.
- What the fee excludes: media spend, creative production, revisions and tracking setup.
- How you cancel, and what happens to campaigns and creative files after you leave.


Our[how to choose a Facebook ads agency](https://knowlify.com/articles/how-to-choose-a-facebook-ads-agency) guide covers the questions in more depth, and our[Facebook ad agency pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-ad-agency-pricing) explains common fee models.


## Key takeaways


- Meta ads management covers setup, launches, testing, optimization, tracking and reporting, usually in your own ad account.
- Media spend is a separate cost. Compare management fees and creative costs, not media.
- Agencies publish fees in different shapes, so compare the total at the spend you plan.
- Ask how many original concepts each month, because Meta's automation makes creative supply a bigger part of the job.
- Knowlify offers optional end-to-end Meta management or creative-only work, and a person checks every ad before delivery.


## FAQ


### What does a Facebook ads management agency actually do?


It sets up and launches campaigns, tests creative, adjusts budgets and bids, sets up tracking and reports results, usually in your own ad account. Some agencies also make the creative, and some leave it to you. Ask for the scope in writing before you compare fees.


### What does a Facebook ads specialist do?


A specialist runs the account day to day, often on one channel and without a creative team. That fits a business that already has creative and needs someone to run it. An agency fits when you need strategy, creative and campaign work from one team.


### What is Instagram ads management?


It is managing Instagram placements, Feed, Stories and Reels, inside Meta's campaign system, with a shape for each one. Meta recommends 9:16 video with audio for Reels, with key messages inside the safe zone. Add captions for viewers who have sound off, and check that each ad fits every placement.


### Is media spend included in Meta ads management?


Usually not. Media is paid to Meta as a separate line, alongside the management fee and the cost of making the ads. Ask whether a quote includes any media, and check Meta's minimum budget for your country and objective before you set a daily budget.


### How long should a Meta campaign run before you judge it?


Meta advises running an ad for at least 7 days so the system can learn. Judge results on enough conversions rather than a few days of spend, and avoid large edits while the test runs.
